name: Joel R. Bryant
tagline: Top rated Elder Law attorney in San Diego, California
education: University of San Diego School of Law
about: Handling nursing home abuse, financial elder abuse, will & trust fraud, and inheritance dispute cases, attorney Joel R. Bryant is recognized as one of San Diego's top litigation attorneys. Practicing with the San Diego, California, firm of Green, Bryant & French, LLP, Mr. Bryant was one of the first attorneys in San Diego to focus on prosecuting civil and probate actions for financial elder abuse. He is one of the few attorneys experienced and successful in both nursing home abuse and financial elder abuse litigation. Mr. Bryant's more than 30 years of experience has included extensive trial experience, and he enjoys an excellent reputation throughout the legal community as an aggressive and compassionate advocate for his clients.

With his breadth and depth of experience, Mr. Bryant is able to translate his knowledge into superior results for his clients. He has been awarded Consumer Attorneys of San Diego's Outstanding Trial Lawyer Award and has received several President's Awards for Excellence. He was also rated AV* Preeminent by Martindale-Hubbell, that organization's highest legal rating for ethical standards and legal ability.

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are registered certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the confidential opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards.
